specs.Item Type Name: USB Mouse Jiggler & Auto Clicker– Undetectable Cursor Shaker & Vibration Device–

features: ✅ UNDETECTABLE MOUSE JIGGLER – KEEPS CURSOR MOVING AUTOMATICALLY WITHOUT DETECTION: Automatically moves your cursor without detection — preventing inactivity timeouts, screen locks, and sleep mode while you are away from your desk. Ideal for remote workers, professionals, and gamers who need their system to stay active and awake during meetings, presentations, and extended sessions.

✅ PLUG & PLAY – NO SOFTWARE OR DRIVERS REQUIRED, READY IN SECONDS: Simply plug into any USB port and it works instantly — no additional software, drivers, or setup required whatsoever. A completely hassle free plug and play solution to keep your desktop or laptop screen active and awake with zero configuration needed straight out of the box.

✅ AUTO CLICKER MODE – 1 CLICK PER SECOND FOR GAMING, TESTING & REPETITIVE TASKS: In Auto Clicker mode, the device clicks precisely once per second automatically — perfect for tasks requiring repetitive clicking such as gaming, software testing, and automation. Saves valuable time and effort with reliable, consistent, and precise clicking action every single second.

✅ LONG PRESS ON/OFF & SHORT PRESS TO SWITCH MODES – SIMPLE ONE BUTTON CONTROL: Designed for effortless one button control — long press to turn the device on or off, short press to switch between Auto Clicker mode and cursor jiggler mode instantly. Simple, intuitive controls provide complete flexibility to suit different tasks, workflows, and user preferences.

✅ COMPATIBLE WITH WINDOWS & LINUX – WORKS WITH DESKTOPS & LAPTOPS SEAMLESSLY: Works seamlessly with both Windows and Linux operating systems across all desktops and laptops — no compatibility concerns whatsoever. A versatile plug and play tool for remote workers, gamers, software testers, and professionals who need reliable, undetectable system activity at all times.
